summary: Chime Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 financial results and disclosing a new share repurchase authorization. On May 4, 2026, the board approved a $200 million repurchase of Class A common stock, to be executed through open market or private transactions, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, with no fixed obligation or timeline. The company also raised full-year guidance. As a capital return event, the buyback signals management's confidence in undervaluation. Monitor execution pace and any insider selling for risk-arb perspective; no premium or close date applies.
